","content":"

On Saturday August 17, it’s the Kauai Farm Fair Tribute celebrating our island’s farmers, ranchers and backyard gardeners.

Come early and bring your fruits & veggies from the farm or garden to enter in the Fruit & Vegetable Show from 8:00am to 10:00am.

At 11:00am come on down for a variety of themed activities hosted by Kauai County Farm Bureau and community partners including US Department of Agriculture, UH College of Tropical Agriculture, KCC and Future Farmers, Master Gardeners and more!

Enjoy a popup exhibit and sale by the Kauaʻi Bonsai Club and Garden Island Orchid Society next to Sone’s, plus Kauai Grown members and a centerwide K+M Market featuring local products and treats from noon to 6!  Bring the ohana and support local agriculture while celebrating our community.
